messages:
Priya (People Ops): FYI — Lucas submitted his resignation today, last official day 2026-03-31. We need to coordinate COBRA/benefits packet, final payroll, and access removal timing.
Aaron (Eng Manager): Got it. He's got a handful of migration tasks. Would like to request a 2-week access extension for handoff. Can that be done?
Priya (People Ops): Manager extensions are allowed but need approvals from People Ops + Eng manager. Also we need to confirm final payroll date and whether he receives any prorated benefits.
Lucas (Product): I'm happy to do the handoff. Extension is fine on my side — prefer to keep audit logs intact.
IT Support: We can keep accounts live for a limited extension. Need formal approval in thread and an explicit list of systems to retain. Example list we need in the request:
```
- Okta / SSO
- GitHub org access
- AWS sandbox account
- Jira/Confluence
- Internal analytics dashboards
```
Priya (People Ops): Putting the extension request in the approval queue now. @offboard-bot will create the deprovision workflow with default dates — we can update if approved.
offboard-bot: Automated notice: Offboard workflow created for lucas@example.com. Default deprovision date: 2026-04-15. Approvals pending: People Ops, Eng Manager. View: <https://redwood.example/offboard/1788451234>
Maya (Benefits): Quick COBRA note: employer coverage ends the last day of the termination month. COBRA election window is 60 days from the date the COBRA packet is mailed. With last day 2026-03-31, election deadline is 2026-05-30 (we'll mail the packet by 2026-04-05).
Aaron (Eng Manager): Please cc me on the packet. Also need confirmation of last payroll date and final equity vesting timeline.
Priya (People Ops): CC added for the COBRA packet. Payroll note: submit any final expense / time edits by 2026-04-02; final paycheck scheduled for 2026-04-10. Equity/vesting — routing to Comp team and will update here when I have the response.
Lucas (Product): One operational request — please keep my AWS sandbox and GitHub access through 2026-04-14 so I can run the migration scripts and record steps. I'll put a readme in the repo with the exact commands.
IT Support: Noted. We'll add AWS sandbox + GitHub to the approved extension list pending approvals. Please drop the doc link here when ready.
Priya (People Ops): Extension formally approved by People Ops pending Aaron's confirmation. Aaron, can you confirm in thread so we can finalize deprovision date?
Aaron (Eng Manager): :thumbsup: Confirmed. Approved for sandbox + GitHub until 2026-04-14. People Ops — please update offboard workflow to 2026-04-15 deprovision and keep sandbox exceptions until 2026-04-14.
Priya (People Ops): Done — I updated the workflow and sent the COBRA packet schedule to Benefits. I'll follow up with payroll and comp updates once they respond. Thanks everyone.
